_comment: Pokemon Connect - dynamic gym leader team pools. `species`/`item`/`moves` are Gen3 INTERNAL ROM constants (matching pokeemerald/pokeruby/pokefirered constants/species.h, items.h, moves.h) - NOT always equal to National Dex number (Gen3-native species have a +offset due to reserved slots 252-276). `trainerIds` map gameId -> the numeric TRAINER_* id of that leader's main story battle in gTrainers[] for that game (matched against each gym's trainerId in the base patch manifest). `teamSize` = how many Pokemon are randomly drawn (without repeats) from `pool` to build a generated team; `pool` may contain more entries than `teamSize`. Levels are computed at patch-build time from the traveling trainer's average party level +/- levelVariance (see ConnectTeamPatchService).

leaders.displayName: Juan (Sootopolis Gym - Emerald) / Wallace (Sootopolis Gym - Ruby/Sapphire)
